import Mathlib
open Fintype Subgroup Set Polynomial Ideal
open scoped BigOperators
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem Dummit_Foote_exercise_4_5_14 {G : Type*} [Group G] [Fintype G]
  (hG : card G = 312) :
  ∃ (p : ℕ) (P : Sylow p G), p.Prime ∧ (p ∣ card G) ∧ P.Normal := by
  have hp : Nat.Prime 13 := by
    norm_num
  letI : Fact (13 : ℕ).Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  obtain ⟨P⟩ : Nonempty (Sylow 13 G) := Sylow.nonempty
  
  let n : ℕ := Nat.card (Sylow 13 G)
  
  have hdiv : n ∣ 312 := by
    dsimp [n]
    rw [P.card_eq_index_normalizer]
    exact
      (index_dvd_of_le
        (H := (P : Subgroup G))
        (K := normalizer (P : Set G))
        le_normalizer).trans
        (by
          simpa [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hG] using P.index_dvd_card)
  
  have hnle : n ≤ 312 :=
    Nat.le_of_dvd (by norm_num) hdiv
  
  have hmod : n % 13 = 1 := by
    dsimp [n]
    have hh := card_sylow_modEq_one 13 G
    simpa [Nat.ModEq] using hh
  
  have hn : n = 1 := by
    interval_cases hn : n <;>
      norm_num at hmod <;>
      norm_num at hdiv <;>
      omega
  
  have hs : Subsingleton (Sylow 13 G) :=
    (Nat.card_eq_one_iff_unique.mp (by simpa [n] using hn)).1
  letI : Subsingleton (Sylow 13 G) := hs
  
  refine ⟨13, P, hp, ?_, Sylow.normal_of_subsingleton P⟩
  simpa [hG]
